title: A Teenager Leaked GTA 6... Using a Hotel TV

segments.text: A teenager leaked GTA Six... using a hotel TV.
September twenty twenty-two. Ninety clips of unfinished GTA Six footage appear online.
Police say it was a teenager from England.
And he did it while on bail. From a hotel room.
His laptop had been taken. So he reportedly used an Amazon Fire Stick and the hotel TV.
The clips confirmed two huge rumours. A return to Vice City. And a female lead.
Later, a court ordered him to be held in a secure hospital indefinitely.
Rockstar said the leak wouldn't change the schedule. But it was a gut punch.
